summary: Ohmyhome Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failing the minimum bid price rule (bid price below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days). The company has a 180-day compliance period ending January 11, 2027, to regain compliance by having a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for ten consecutive business days. If unsuccessful, it may seek a second 180-day grace period. The filing is a routine compliance notification that does not constitute a special situation; it is a standard regulatory update on Nasdaq continued listing requirements.
